title: knowledge custom-collector tool output (v1)
description: The MINIMUM output schema a custom collector's MCP tool must advertise, and the schema its structuredContent result is validated against. A tool that advertises no output schema, or one that does not declare at least this, is REFUSED at registration and at collect. walk_complete is the COMPLETENESS ASSERTION: the provider asserts its walk enumerated the whole source. It is required, so a provider cannot omit it and silently disable the deletion phase.

nodes.description: The nodes this collect produced. id and type are required on every node; the remaining fields of the node vocabulary are optional and documented in docs/guides/tools/custom_collector.md.

edges.description: The edges this collect produced. Endpoints are referenced by node id. An edge naming NEITHER source_graph nor target_graph is an edge of this collect's own graph. An edge naming ONE of them has that endpoint in another graph and is resolved into the linkage graph instead; it is never written into this collect's own graph. An edge naming BOTH fails the collect: one resolution reaches one foreign family, so an edge with a foreign node at each end names a relationship this contract cannot resolve.

source_graph.description: OPTIONAL. The graph FAMILY (a graph type, not a graph instance) that from_id lives in — the mirror of target_graph, for an edge whose FOREIGN endpoint is the source rather than the destination. The client enumerates that family's loaded graphs, locates from_id among them, and links the edge into the linkage graph through a proxy. A named family with no loaded graph, an endpoint found in none of them, and a failed enumeration each fail the collect, as does naming source_graph and target_graph on one edge. Omit it for an ordinary edge of this collect's own graph.

target_graph.description: OPTIONAL. The graph FAMILY (a graph type, not a graph instance) that to_id lives in. The client enumerates that family's loaded graphs, locates to_id among them, and links the edge into the linkage graph through a proxy. A named family with no loaded graph, an endpoint found in none of them, and a failed enumeration each fail the collect, as does naming source_graph and target_graph on one edge. Omit it for an ordinary edge of this collect's own graph.

walk_complete.description: The completeness assertion: true when this walk enumerated the whole source. A result asserting false disables the deletion phase for this collect, exactly as an incomplete code walk does.
